description: Add Ha to the red channel of an RGB view in place, where Ha exceeds R by a given fraction. Where Ha > R * (1 + brightness_limit), R becomes R + strength * (Ha - R); elsewhere R, and G and B everywhere, are unchanged. With max_output and rolloff, R above max_output becomes max_output + (R - max_output) * rolloff. Runs as 64-bit PixelMath truncated to [0,1]; reports the new R maximum and the image median and max.

brightness_limit.description: Ha is added only where Ha > R * (1 + brightness_limit)

max_output.description: Optional: R level above which the soft clamp compresses; given together with rolloff. Omitted = no clamp

rolloff.description: Fraction of the excess above max_output that is kept; given together with max_output

strength.description: Fraction of the Ha excess over R added to R

target_id.description: Target RGB view, modified in place

name: ha_inject_red
